description: Modify the Hadron system to ensure the Databricks authentication hook runs consistently across all PostgreSQL versions. Currently, the hook may not be executing in certain scenarios, potentially leaving authentication gaps. This change will guarantee the hook is always invoked during the authentication flow.
functional_requirements: Ensure the Databricks authentication hook executes for every authentication attempt in the PostgreSQL integration
Apply the hook enforcement consistently across all supported PostgreSQL versions (v14 through v17)
Update the vendor configuration files to reflect the permanent activation of the authentication hook
Maintain backward compatibility with existing authentication workflows while ensuring the hook runs
